question: How many people did Iran execute in 2025, per Amnesty International?
answer: Iran carried out about 4 of every 5 of the roughly 2,700 executions confirmed worldwide in 2025. Across the world, 54 states still apply the death penalty. Your slider guess can be compared against the number of people Iran executed.
move: One country did about 80% of the world's confirmed executions in 2025.
